en:
The Exisal passed through the alarm system
and electric barrier to enter the hangar...
That's what I said earlier, right?

<CLT=cltMIND>I made a mistake...
I need to think it over again! <CLT=cltNORMAL>

Didn't you say earlier that four Exisals
were protecting Monokuma?
Don't go back on something you said.

<CLT=cltMIND>I made a mistake...
I need to think it over again! <CLT=cltNORMAL>

Huuuh? I thought I showed everyone that
you can control an Exisal with a remote.

<CLT=cltMIND>I made a mistake...
I need to think it over again! <CLT=cltNORMAL>

The Electrohammer ran out of energy yesterday,
and needed 24 hours to recharge...

To enter the hangar, the hammer should've
been recharging since yesterday, right?

<CLT=cltMIND>I made a mistake...
I need to think it over again! <CLT=cltNORMAL>
It's impossible to enter a moving Exisal.

Unless you're someone who can control
them with a remote.

<CLT=cltMIND>I made a mistake...
I need to think it over again! <CLT=cltNORMAL>
<CLT=cltMIND>It's not impossible.

<CLT=cltMIND>You need an Electrohammer
to bring down an Exisal...

<CLT=cltMIND>And there would be
evidence that it was used!
<CLT=cltMIND>It's not impossible.

<CLT=cltMIND>There is one way to stop an Exisal.
I have to show them!

<CLT=cltMIND>There is one way to stop an Exisal.
I have to show them!
